d: A tanker ship came under attack for the second consecutive day in the Strait of Hormuz, raising fresh concerns over maritime security and tensions in the region. The attack reportedly triggered a fire onboard the vessel, with 27 Indian sailors among those on board. The incident has once again highlighted the growing risks faced by commercial ships navigating this strategically important waterway.
